name: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery has no quest timer (#8969)
contract: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery 3364 starts at Nori Pridedrift 12738 with Durnan's Scalding Mornbrew 10439 and ends at Durnan Furcutter 836. The 3.3.5 quest has TimeAllowed 0 (stock quest_template, coa_world) and its text says the cup stays hot 'for a few more minutes'; only the vanilla text named a five-minute limit. A timed quest fails when its timer runs out, whatever its objectives. Expected: with the mornbrew carried, the quest stays complete after more than five minutes and the mornbrew stays in the bags.
